info.name: Set a Duty Status for a Specific Driver

params.name: driver_id
params.description: ID of the driver for whom the duty status is being set.

items.docs: This endpoint is still on our legacy API. Set an individual drivers current duty status to 'On Duty' or 'Off Duty'. To ensure compliance with the ELD Mandate, only authenticated drivers can make direct duty status changes on their own logbook. Any system external to the Samsara Driver App using this endpoint to trigger duty status changes must ensure that such changes are only triggered directly by the driver in que
